$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IntelliSense support

model.description:
Whisper model size to use. Larger models are more accurate but slower.

- tiny (75 MB): Fastest, least accurate
- base (142 MB): Good balance of speed and accuracy
- small (466 MB): Good accuracy, moderate speed
- medium (1.5 GB): High accuracy, slower
- large-v3 (3.1 GB): Best accuracy, requires GPU
- large-v3-turbo (1.6 GB): Optimized large model

Models ending in '.en' are English-only but faster.

runtime.description:
Compute runtime for inference.

- auto: Automatically detect best available runtime
- cpu: Run on CPU (always available, slowest)
- cuda: NVIDIA GPU acceleration (requires NVIDIA GPU + CUDA)
- rocm: AMD GPU acceleration (requires AMD GPU + ROCm)
- vulkan: Cross-platform GPU acceleration (experimental)

language.description:
Transcription language.

- auto: Auto-detect language (slightly slower)
- en: English
- es: Spanish (Español)
- fr: French (Français)
- de: German (Deutsch)
- it: Italian (Italiano)
- pt: Portuguese (Português)
- ru: Russian (Русский)
- zh: Chinese (中文)
- ja: Japanese (日本語)
- ko: Korean (한국어)
- ar: Arabic (العربية)
- hi: Hindi (हिन्दी)
- nl: Dutch (Nederlands)
- pl: Polish (Polski)
- tr: Turkish (Türkçe)
- vi: Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt)
- th: Thai (ไทย)
- id: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
- uk: Ukrainian (Українська)
- cs: Czech (Čeština)

version.description: Settings schema version for migrations. Do not modify manually.
